title: bridge: RQ-REBASE-PHANTOM-4169
body:
Automated bridge job `RQ-REBASE-PHANTOM-4169` (pool: codex-cmp), single commit on base `54b9a6429`.

**Tests:** no test command

**Sensitive paths (needs Security OK):** contrib/mac/publish.sh 

**Tier-1 (CODEOWNERS) paths, async post-merge review:** .github/CODEOWNERS src/core/authority/action-classes.ts src/core/vision/leader-apply.ts test/fixtures/authority/tier1-closure.json

<details><summary>Agent notes</summary>

# RQ-REBASE-PHANTOM-4169 — HOLD: existing PR only

## Outcome

Prepared an uncommitted conflict-resolution candidate for existing PR
https://github.com/ashlrai/phantom/pull/4169. **Not pushed, updated remotely,
enqueued, merged, or CI-green. Do not create a replacement PR.**

PR observed OPEN, head `5b591ddfcbbf5eb442f83769bdce6b3c918eb7c4`, branch
`masonwyatt23/phantom:codex-bridge/RQ-SWE5-ACTION-CLASSES`.
Fetched default branch and fast-forwarded this local job branch to
`306ef16aa58543eb15daaa02719ee2141b3e1fe0`, then applied the PR's single commit
with `git cherry-pick --no-commit`. Resolved conflicts and exited cherry-pick
state without making a commit. This is a local candidate on the job branch,
not an updated PR branch or a completed rebase.

## Changes

- Preserved current dispatcher imports, phase-based reaping, work-market and
  batch-session conditions, process spawning, metrics, and bundle cleanup.
- Moved the action-class publication check into the current `reap_worktrees`
  phase. Preserved all existing installation files and completion verbs.
- Regenerated the fleet command registry; retained existing Tier-1 snapshot
  entries and merged the original PR's action-class entries. No broad snapshot
  regeneration or Security pin changes.
- Fixed two independently reproduced defects in the original PR: configured
  publishable gates could admit forbidden actions, and non-string job-class
  references could crash validation. Added four regression test methods.
- No unrelated files or tests were removed, and no test timeouts were raised.

## Blocking conditions

1. Task requests updating/enqueuing the existing PR, but its final RULES also
   explicitly prohibit commit/push/publish and require uncommitted changes.
   Clarification was requested; no answer received at report preparation.
   No remote mutation was attempted.
2. The PR changes `contrib/mac/publish.sh`, a retained Security GATES pin
   boundary. GitHub returned no submitted review or Security approval.
   The proposed publisher executes a new helper before its scrub trap and
   existing integrity checks; trust/pinning of both the helper and authority
   JSON requires explicit Security review. Local tests do not supply a pin.
   No live dispatcher, publisher, installer, or release machinery was changed.
3. Local `gh` cannot read `/Users/masonwyatt/.config/gh/config.yml` (EPERM).
   Read-only GitHub connector/public API inspection worked; no credential
   workaround was used. Merge Gate has no reported run on the existing PR head.
4. Broader local verification is not green; see results below. Vercel is not
   treated as a required check.

Only the original fork head above may be published after the blockers are
resolved, through the sanctioned publisher. Do not invoke a default publisher
mode that opens a PR for this job branch.

## Commands and evidence

Read-only/setup:

- `git status --short --branch`, `git log -5 --oneline`, affected-path log,
  `git remote -v`, `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` (shallow checkout).
- `gh pr view 4169 -R ashlrai/phantom --json state,mergedAt,url,title,headRefName,headRepositoryOwner,headRepository,baseRefName,mergeable,mergeStateStatus,statusCheckRollup`
  failed before network access because its config was inaccessible.
- Public PR REST API and GitHub connector `get_pr_info`, `fetch_pr_comments`,
  `fetch_commit_workflow_runs`; delegated read-only review also checked
  check-runs/reviews. No required workflow run or Security approval found.
- `entire resume codex-bridge/RQ-REBASE-PHANTOM-4169`: no checkpoint found.
- `node --version`: v22.22.3. `npm install -g @ashlr/phantom` failed EPERM
  creating a directory in the configured global installation prefix.
- Existing installed `phm docs --agent --json` and `phm mcp list --json`
  succeeded; `phm wire status --json` exited 1 (gateway unwired/config access
  limitations). No client/auth configuration changed.
- `git fetch --no-tags origin refs/pull/4169/head`
- `git fetch --no-tags origin master`
- `git merge --ff-only FETCH_HEAD`
- `git cherry-pick --no-commit 5b591ddfcbbf5eb442f83769bdce6b3c918eb7c4`
  initially reported five conflicts; all resolved locally.
- `git add` the five resolved paths; `git cherry-pick --quit`.
- `git restore --staged --` the 15 candidate paths at handoff: all changes are
  uncommitted and unstaged; no index conflicts remain.
- `node scripts/gen-fleet-registry.mjs`: PASS.
- `bash -n contrib/mac/publish.sh contrib/mac/install.sh`: PASS.
- `git diff --check HEAD`: PASS.

Verification (test runs use a newly created temporary HOME):

- From `contrib/mac/tests`, `python3 -B -m unittest test_action_classes`:
  **21 passed, 0 failed** (173.518 seconds), including dispatcher integration.
- `npm run test:ci -- test/authority-action-classes.test.ts test/leader-apply-310b.test.ts test/authority-tier1-closure-310b.test.ts test/authority-codeowners-310b.test.ts test/fleet-registry-help.test.ts test/doc-facts.test.ts test/tier1-apps-boundary.test.ts`:
  **490 passed, 19 failed**, 7 files, 406.80 seconds.
  - Action classes: 19/19 PASS; Tier-1 closure: 4/4 PASS.
  - Nine existing fleet help constants missing: assign, attachments, board,
    claim, handoff, inbox, merge-identity, post, release. Independent comparison
    confirms these handlers and failures are unchanged from fetched master.
  - Existing docs/completion mismatch: AGENTS.md documents `apps request`, but
    the unchanged apps completion array omits `request`.
  - Two existing apps-boundary failures: apps-recovery-history,
    apps-recovery-invocations, and apps-recovery-verdict already occur in the
    baseline Tier-1 closure; the reported runtime chain is unrelated to this
    PR's new authority module.
  - Six Leader cases exceeded their existing 5-second limit; the CODEOWNERS
    coverage case exceeded its existing 30-second limit. No timeout increased.
- `node scripts/verify-changed.mjs`: file selection and fleet registry PASS;
  authority subrun **9 passed, 1 failed** (CODEOWNERS 30-second timeout).
  Exited before ESLint/typecheck phases. The generated owner block and closure
  checks passed; no ownership assertion established missing entries.
- `npm run check:docs`: PASS, zero errors (261 local/400 source links).
- Initial `npm run typecheck`: could not start, `tsgo: command not found`.
- Initial `npm run lint`: could not start, ESLint `../lib/cli` missing.
- `pnpm --version`: 10.28.2.
- `npm run install:worktree`: PASS with pnpm 10.28.2; frozen install completed
  in 20,729 ms; `wt-deps` and `tsc-warm` healing both succeeded.
- Repeated `npm run typecheck` after dependency repair: PASS (backend and web).
- Serial retry `npm run test:ci -- --maxWorkers=1 --fileParallelism=false test/leader-apply-310b.test.ts`:
  **47 passed, 0 failed**, 9.67 seconds total. Same timeout limits; all six
  earlier timed-out cases passed. Used a fresh temporary HOME.
- Repeated `node scripts/verify-changed.mjs` after dependency repair and the
  initial timeout failure: **PASS**. Authority tests **10/10 PASS**, changed-file
  ESLint, backend typecheck, fleet registry, and route I/O checks all passed.
  Real-I/O lint reported existing unchanged-file warnings, which this command
  classifies separately. The earlier CODEOWNERS timeout passed without changing
  its limit. Recorded verification tree `4a3ac5980e75`.
- From `contrib/mac/tests`, `python3 -m unittest test_dispatchd test_install test_batching test_batch_sessions test_work_market`:
  **127 passed, 0 failed**, 853.819 seconds; temporary HOME. Together with the
  action-class suite: **148 Python tests passed**, no failures.
- `npm run dev -- fleet action-classes --json` with temporary HOME: PASS,
  emitted the eight-class `action-classes.v1` projection through source CLI.
- Repeated full `npm run lint` after dependency repair: completed, exit 1,
  **3 errors, 273 warnings**. All three errors are existing `no-control-regex`
  violations in unchanged files: `test/leader-reply-clean-original-238s.test.ts`
  lines 74 and 99, and `test/leader-status-reply.test.ts` line 44. Full log:
  `/tmp/phantom-4169-lint.log`. Downstream full-lint scripts did not execute
  because ESLint failed; `verify-changed` separately ran its applicable checks.

Latest outcomes: 148/148 Python tests pass; action-class TS 19/19, Leader 47/47,
authority 10/10, source CLI, typecheck, changed-file lint, verify-changed, and
docs validation pass. Twelve broader TS assertion failures remain on unchanged
baseline inputs; full ESLint also retains three baseline errors. No claim of
full local CI or hosted Merge Gate success is made. All verification processes
have finished; none was stopped or left running.

## Diff size and session

Source candidate versus fetched master: **15 files, +1,255 / -6, net +1,249 LOC**.
This includes the original feature, not just rebase repairs. The validator fix
adds net 41 LOC over the original PR. This notes file is additional documentation.

No commits, pushes, tags, branch/tag deletion, PR creation, merge requests,
workflow dispatches, live installs, or Security pin changes. Entire had no
checkpoint to resume and no new checkpoint was created through a commit.
Companion MCP tools used: none.

Final read-only GitHub recheck still reports OPEN with the original head SHA
`5b591ddfcbbf5eb442f83769bdce6b3c918eb7c4`; acceptance is not satisfied.
</details>
